verses.mystical_translation: When the heart grows faint, refuge can be imagined as ground higher than the crisis.
The poem enters through distance, refuge, king imagery, allowing what is real to be named before it is transformed.
Its center asks what becomes possible when fear, power, memory, and relationship are held in the presence of the Divine rather than acted out automatically.
